sources.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B tensor-level abliterated, vision tower and MTP head untouched. 0% over-refusal on XSTest, 0-6% refusal across the A/B suite, no measurable capability loss. Full mmproj vision, tool calling and thinking, 262K context.

sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX is a 27-billion-parameter vision-language model built by orcarouter that runs on Apple Silicon through MLX quantization. It is based on Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B architecture, which uses hybrid attention combining 48 Gated DeltaNet linear layers with 16 full attention layers across 64 total layers and 5120 hidden dimensions.
